name: Lightweight Weather & Skies
description: Lightweight clouds, weather and celestial effects for Battle Art on PC, standalone Quest, and experimental non-VR Android. Host requirements and test status are in the README.
credits: Lightweight derivative of The World by MrKrisSatan, incorporating weather work from releases 6.58.1 and 6.70.27. The project owner reports permission from MrKrisSatan/THCrazy to make a light-performance version, initially for Quest and intended for broader compatibility. This is not an upstream release or a new license grant over upstream material. Audio credits and the bundled lib/voxel_atmos MIT license and notice are retained.
